CrawlEngine with defaults scrapes a page identically to the free function

```rust title="Rust"
use crawlberg::scrape;
use crawlberg::create_engine;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine = create_engine(None).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let url = r#"https://example.com"#.to_string();
    let result = scrape(&engine, &url).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.status_code);
    println!("{:?}", result.content_type);
    println!("{:?}", result.metadata.title);
    println!("{:?}", result.metadata.description);
    println!("{:?}", result.links.len());
    println!("{:?}", result.metadata.headings.as_ref().unwrap().len());
}
```
